description: Test suite for Vitest configuration functions and system load parsing, including tests for resolving worker counts, scheduling, parsing process stats, and default config behaviors.

methods.name: resolveLocalVitestMaxWorkers
methods.description: Determines maximum workers based on system and environment variables.

methods.name: resolveLocalVitestScheduling
methods.description: Decides how to schedule Vitest worker processes based on current system load and configuration.

methods.name: parseVitestProcessStats
methods.description: Analyzes process list output to count Vitest related processes excluding the current process.

methods.name: resolveDefaultVitestPool
methods.description: Provides default pool configuration for Vitest testing framework.
